applicationProfileDefinition.en: Geographical object that can be identified by an address.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Is abstract, i.e. the type of addressable object must always be specified (e.g. building unit, plot).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Someone who or something that can act or bring about an effect.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Membership of an agent of an organization.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Membership of an agent of an organization.
Refers to the registered organization with which the agent is associated.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: For example, a sole proprietorship operated by a natural person or a non-registered organisation that includes several registered organisations.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Unspecified membership of an agent of an organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en:
Covers any type of affiliation or involvement of an agent in an organization, not just formal membership. Can possibly be further specialized.

Membership is described in more detail with the entity membership (by means of association class modeling).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the organization that an agent heads or directs.
Indicates the position of an agent (typically at the organization where the position is defined).
Refers to the Agent to whom the Agent is accountable.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Combined with Position reportsTo-Position, the organization chart of the Organization can be documented.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Agent with a position.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Allow a function to act, e.g. in the context of a service (e.g. diversity plan is drawn up by diversity officer).

vocabularyDefinition.en: Information such as email, telephone... which allows the Capacity to be contacted.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Information such as email, telephone... which allows the capacity to be contacted.
Event that causes an organization to undergo a significant change, such as a merger or restructuring.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Intended for situations where the resulting organization differs from the original organization to such an extent that it can be considered a new organization.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Date the event occurred.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: See for example Time and date & Recurring and partial dates of https://www.w3.org/TR/rdf11-concepts/#h3_xsd-datatypes

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization for this underwent the change.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Note that this relationship is meaningless if the moment of change is a creation (a creation is not a change to an existing organization).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization that emerged from the change.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Note that this relationship is meaningless if the moment of change is a cessation (a cessation cannot lead to a new organization).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the formal framework that led to the moment of change.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: If the moment of change relates to the establishment of a public organisation, this attribute is mandatory. This is expressed by means of the constraint obligatoryIfEstablishmentPublicOrganization.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Event where an organization was shut down.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Reason why the Organization has been discontinued.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Reason why the organization has been stopped.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: E.g. retirement, bankruptcy...

applicationProfileDefinition.en: An office or other building where an organization is located. Organizations can be spread across multiple locations, and branches can strike at multiple locations.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Most of the time, the establishment will be a physical location. However, non-physical locations are not excluded, e.g. a virtual office with associated postal number and telephone reception.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Address of the branch.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Can be email, telephone and also address (in which case non-physical addresses are also possible).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Addressable object that corresponds to the establishment.
Refers to a place where the organization is present in one way or another, if necessary indirectly.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Indirectly, for example, a virtual office whose location cannot be traced directly (e.g. PO box). In Belgium, organisations registered in the CBE may only register physical locations as establishments.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the organization's principal establishment, not necessarily the formal headquarters but the establishment where the organization can be contacted by default.
Refers to the legally registered establishment of the organization. Is usually mandatory for a formal organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Mandatory in Belgium for a regulated organization and registered in the CBE.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Event where an organization was founded.
Event in which two organizations are formed from one organization.
Set of formal documents that describe rules, rights, obligations towards citizens, governments, companies, etc.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: The documents in question are laws, policy documents, regulations, contracts, etc.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Name of the formal framework.
A recognised organisation, recognised in a broad sense or more specifically in a legal sense with associated rights and obligations.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: For example, a company, a non-profit organization, a government body, a church community.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Displays the characteristics of an agent's membership of an organization.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Organization to which the membership (of an agent) relates.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization to which the membership (of an agent) relates.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Membership of an agent (of an organization).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Membership of an agent (of an organization).
Period in which the agent was a member of the organization.
Role that the agent fulfills as a member of the organization.
Event in which two organizations together form a new organization.
Type of activity carried out by an organisation.
Ranking of an organization in a classification system.
Situation of organization.
Type of organization.

A number of people organized into a community or other social, commercial, or political structure. The group has a common goal or raison d'être that transcends its individual members and can act as an agent. An organization often has a hierarchical structure.
Type of activity carried out by the organisation.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Specialization of the attribute classification (in addition to type & status).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Other name by which the organization is known.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: E.g. commercial name, informal name...

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Ranking of the organization in a classification system.
Information such as email, telephone... that allows the Organisation to be contacted.
Description of the organization.
Refers to a position in the organization.
Agent who is a member (of an organization).

applicationProfileUsageNote.en:
Covers any type of affiliation or involvement of an agent in an organization, not just formal membership. Can possibly be further specialized.

Membership is described in more detail with the entity membership (by means of association class modeling).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the moment of change that changed this organization.
Refers to a place where the organization is present in one way or another, if necessary indirectly.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Indirectly, for example, a virtual office whose location cannot be traced directly (e.g. PO box). In Belgium, organisations registered in the CBE may only register physical locations as establishments.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the organization's principal establishment, not necessarily the formal headquarters but the establishment where the organization can be contacted by default.
Refers to the legally registered establishment of the organization. Is usually mandatory for a formal organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Mandatory in Belgium for a regulated organization and registered in the CBE.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization that is a subsidiary or part of the organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Used to document a hierarchy of organizations.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to an organizational unit that is part of the organization, e.g. a department.
Address of the homepage of the website of the organization.
Unspecified relationship with another organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: E.g. to document subsidies or supply chains. In that case, it needs to be further specialized.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization that includes this organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Used to document a hierarchy of organizations.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Refers to the moment of change that led to the current organization.
Reference to the logo of the organization.
Name with which the organization is preferably indicated.
Reason for the organization's existence.
Condition of the organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Specialization of classification (in addition to type & activity).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Type of organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Specialization of classification (in addition to activity & status).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: An organization such as a department or service that is part of the larger organization and derives its raison d'être from it. Has no legal status in itself.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Organizational units can be large, complex, and consist of other organizational units.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization of which the organizational unit is a part.
Collaboration between two or more organizations, e.g. in the context of a project.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Is normally not a formal organization and not an organizational unit. Typically has a shorter lifespan than the organizations in the band. Alternative names: project, consortium.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Natural person.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: In case law, it concerns a person (in the legal sense, i.e. with its own legal personality) of the human species, i.e. a physical person. Counterpart is the legal entity, a legal construction that gives a private or public organization the same legal personality as a natural person (e.g. can also have debts, conclude contracts, be sued, etc.).

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Reference to a branch where a person is stationed.

vocabularyDefinition.en: A spatial area or named place.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: A spatial area or named place.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Geometry of the place or area.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Geometry of the place or area.

vocabularyDefinition.en: Name of the place or area.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Name of the place or area.
Function within an organization, can exist separately from the person or persons who fill it.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Also allows to display official positions. For example, a minister is automatically a member of the government, regardless of the person who holds this position.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Indicates which agent has a position (typically at the organization where the position is defined).
Organization where the position exists.
Refers to the position to which a position is accountable.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Combined with Agent-reportsTo-Agent, the organization chart of the organization can be documented.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Indicates the nature of the function.
An Organisation that belongs to the public sector according to a legal framework, regardless of the level of government at which that framework is in force.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: The public and semi-public organisations that can be classified as public sector are referred to in European Directive 2003/98/EC as "public bodies" and defined as: "the State, regional or local authorities, bodies governed by public law, associations formed by one or more of such bodies or one or more of such bodies governed by public law". And a body governed by public law means 'any body which (a) has been established for the specific purpose of meeting needs in the general interest, not having an industrial or commercial character, and (b) has legal personality, and (c) the activities of which are financed, for the most part, by the State, regional or local authorities or by other bodies governed by public law,  either the management is subject to supervision by the latter, or more than half of the members of the administrative, managerial or supervisory board are appointed by the State, regional or local authorities or other bodies governed by public law.';

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Administrative area covering the Public Organisation.
Nature of legal personality.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Legal personality means that one is a legal subject, i.e. bearer of rights and obligations. Natural persons automatically have legal personality, legal persons (e.g. companies) must be granted this by operation of law.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Status of a registered organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Corresponds to the legal situation in the CBE, e.g. normal situation, judicial composition, opening of bankruptcy, etc.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Legal status of a registered organisation.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Corresponds to the legal form in the CBE, e.g. NV, VZW, City/Municipality, OCMW etc.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Organization with a legal status established by registration. Compare with a formal organization where this status can also be obtained in another way.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: In Belgium, the following organizations must register: company (nv, bvba etc), sole proprietorship, government body, foundation, etc. Upon registration, the organisation receives a company number and its details are entered into the CBE.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Legally registered name of the organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Possibly in different languages.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Indicates whether the legal personality of the registered organisation is that of a natural person or of a legal person.

vocabularyUsageNote.en: A legal entity is a legal construction that gives an Organization the same legal personality as a natural person (e.g. can also have debts, conclude contracts, be sued, etc.). E.g. legal entities under private law: companies, non-profit organisations, etc.; e.g. legal entities under public law: cities, municipalities, etc. In principle, a de facto association is not a legal entity.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Event where one organization is replaced by another.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: For example, restarting the company after technical bankruptcy.

applicationProfileDefinition.en: Role that an agent can fulfill within an organization.

applicationProfileUsageNote.en: Can be a role in connection with a membership or in connection with a position.
